title: Flick core: modules, event bus, control socket
Quality gates: Rust check:all (fmt, clippy pedantic subset, test, custom checks) + CI + pre-commit
description:
Port the os-eco check:all standard (~/Projects/os-eco/docs/check-all-standard.md, template ~/Projects/os-eco/templates/l5-toolkit/) to Rust.

Runner: scripts/check-all.sh with the same contract as check-all.ts: gates run in a fixed order; each prints one ✓/✗ line with its time; on failure it prints only lines matching error/warning/FAILED/panicked/budget (or the last 25 lines) plus a re-run hint; --bail; CHECK_ALL_VERBOSE=1.

Gates, in order:
1. lint: cargo fmt --check (rustfmt.toml max_width=100) + cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -D warnings. Lints go in Cargo.toml [lints]: clippy all=deny, pedantic=warn, plus unwrap_used, expect_used, panic, todo, dbg_macro, undocumented_unsafe_blocks, multiple_unsafe_ops_per_block, allow_attributes_without_reason, too_many_lines, cognitive_complexity (clippy.toml threshold 15). Relax the FFI-noisy pedantic lints. Existing violations use #[expect(..., reason)].
2. check:layers: unsafe/objc2/CF only under src/platform; src/core imports no platform; modules never import each other. Grep script, rules in scripts/layer-rules.toml, every allow entry has a why. Starts as a no-op until flick-ee5b lands.
3. check:agents: backticked paths and commands in AGENTS.md must exist (port of validate-agents-md.ts).
4. check:deps: cargo machete + cargo deny check (advisories, licenses, sources).
5. check:size: file-size ratchet, 500 lines, src/**/*.rs + tests; budgets in scripts/file-size-budgets.json; stale entries fail.
6. check:debt: TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX must cite flick-xxxx, #N or a URL; path:line allowlist; stale entries fail.
7. check:binary-size: release binary ratchet (start at 5 MB).
8. check:coverage: cargo llvm-cov over the pure modules (core/, config, store, search) with an up-only floor in scripts/coverage-budgets.json.
9. check:ci-parity: CI runs scripts/check-all.sh only, so parity holds by construction; the script only asserts that.

Skip jscpd (it is a Node tool and the codebase is small); revisit later.
Hooks: scripts/hooks/pre-commit runs the full check-all.sh (warren policy: if a check is too slow for the hook, fix the check), with GIT_* env vars unset. Install it with scripts/setup.sh (git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks).
Every ratchet budget only moves one way, and the scripts never edit their own budgets.

title: Key triggers module: chords + hyperkey (replaces Hammerspoon, Hyperkey)
description: One shared CGEventTap in platform with 5s re-arm (macOS silently disables taps after sleep/timeouts/TCC changes). Config: [[keys.chord]] with on_down/on_up actions (shell command or HTTP request) — first user: right-cmd+right-opt push-to-talk to kota-voice (http://localhost:8600/pipeline/listen/{start,stop}), replacing ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua. Hyper: Caps Lock held = cmd+ctrl+alt+shift, tapped = Escape (configurable).

title: App manager: list, quit, force-quit, reveal, uninstall with leftovers
description: Extend apps module with an actions view per app. Uninstall: find leftovers by bundle id under ~/Library/{Application Support,Caches,Preferences,Containers,Group Containers,Saved Application State,HTTPStorages,WebKit,Logs,LaunchAgents}; show paths + sizes; confirm; move to Trash with NSFileManager trashItemAtURL (never rm). CLI: flick apps uninstall <name> --dry-run.

title: herdr module: monitor agents across machines and jump to them
description: v1 only monitors and jumps (roots r-5052); no replies, no chat UI. Thin client over herdr's socket API (herdr api schema/snapshot; agent list/read/wait; --machine); never implement SSH/transport in Flick. Shows agents on all machines, waiting-on-me first, with a preview of recent output; activating one focuses its herdr pane. Optional notification when an agent starts to wait. Prefer an event stream from herdr over polling (check api schema first). Replies are a later, separate seed, and only if they are easy.

title: Activity module: event-driven app/window/idle tracking (replaces Rize)
description: Privacy first (roots r-5f73). Recording is easy to turn on and off: a launcher command, an optional hotkey, and a visible indicator while it records. Data stays on this machine until I give explicit permission for a remote use. Spans are written to SQLite on Event::AppActivated + AX window-title change + idle threshold (CGEventSourceSecondsSinceLastEventType); no polling loop. Categorization uses config rules (app/title regex -> project/category). A small local model for what the rules miss comes later. CLI: flick activity today|week [--json]. Browser URLs deferred (they need per-browser AppleScript).

title: Tasks module: tasks + time tracking on top of activity spans
description: Minimal task store (title, project, status). Starting a task attributes subsequent activity spans to it; idle pauses it. Launcher: start/stop/switch task, today's totals. CLI: flick task start|stop|ls|report [--json] so agents can read and write tasks. Depends on activity module.

title: Agent bridge: Flick as sensor + store, an agent session (claude/pi) as the copilot
description: Far-future stretch; do not design yet (roots r-5f73: cart before horse). No agent loop in Flick. Flick exposes its state through the CLI. The bridge spawns claude/pi; remote models are acceptable here. Activity data reaches it only through the explicit remote permission defined in flick-a513.

title: Capture module: screenshots + screen annotation (replaces Shottr, Presentify)
description: ScreenCaptureKit region/window capture to clipboard and file; minimal annotation. Click-through overlay window for drawing/cursor highlight. Backlog.
